site_title: Teknologappen — activities and tickets at LTH
site_description: Discover student activities at LTH, buy tickets and keep everything you need in one place.
hero_title: Activities, tickets and student life — in one place.
hero_description: Teknologappen brings together what is happening across LTH. Discover activities, buy tickets and keep them ready when it is time to go.
install_description: Choose how you want to use Tappen.
install_android_unavailable: The Android app has not been uploaded yet. Use the web app for now — it works directly in your browser.
install_play_store_soon: Coming soon — the Android app is being prepared for upload.
about_title: Less friction between finding something and being there.
about_description: Teknologappen is a shared platform for LTH's student guilds and groups. It is developed openly by students to make activities and ticketing simpler for organisers and participants alike.
feature_discover_description: See upcoming activities from the guilds and groups you care about.
feature_tickets_description: Buy and keep your tickets in one place, ready when you arrive.
feature_community_description: One shared service, built to work across guild and committee boundaries.
legal_intro: The following information applies to ticket purchases made through Teknologappen.
withdrawal_description: Tickets sold through Teknologappen concern events or similar leisure activities supplied on a specified date or during a specified period. Under Chapter 2, Section 11, item 12 of the Swedish Distance Contracts Act (2005:59), the statutory right of withdrawal therefore does not apply. All ticket purchases are final.
complaints_description: Complaints are not applicable either, as we sell services and experiences. Contact the person responsible for the activity or your student guild board for more information.

footer_description: A shared app for activities and tickets at LTH.
